A.explanation: Pressure has magnitude in $\text{Pa}$ but no single direction, it acts normal to a surface at a point, so it is a scalar.

B.explanation: Temperature has magnitude in $\text{K}$ or $^{\circ}\text{C}$ but no direction, so it is a scalar.

C.explanation: Weight is the gravitational force $W = mg$ and acts vertically downwards, so it has both magnitude and direction.

D.explanation: Work $W = Fd\cos\theta$ is energy transferred with magnitude in $\text{J}$ but no direction, so it is a scalar.

walkthrough: Identify what is asked: select the one quantity from pressure, temperature, weight and work that has both magnitude and direction.
